question.text: Swagruha's Niwas project repaired 1,265 families' homes in Dharavi Phase 2 at Rs. 4.67 Cr (Jan 2019-Dec 2022). The SIA's Investment Efficiency KPI is:

answer.text: Total project cost / Number of families benefited — expressing cost per family, here Rs. 4.67 Cr / 1,265 ≈ Rs. 36,917 per family

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the Chapter 8 Niwas KPI definition: Cost per family = Total project cost / Number of families benefited = Rs. 4,67,00,000 / 1,265 ≈ Rs. 36,917 per family. This is the Investment Efficiency indicator. The Trap: Options A, C, D are nonsensical combinations.
